veranderings.voor: Hulle het die sagte klei met patrone
veranderings.na: Terwyl die klei nog sag was, het hulle die pot met patrone
veranderings.rede: One decorates the pot, not 'the soft clay'; this also breaks the run of two sentences opening with 'Hulle het' while keeping that the decorating happened before drying.
'net gedroog' can be read as 'has just dried'; 'slegs' makes clear it means a pot that was dried but not baked.

veranderings.voor: Hulle is van die algemeenste dinge
veranderings.na: Sulke skerwe is van die algemeenste dinge
veranderings.rede: 'Hulle' directly follows 'kleipotte' and can be read as the whole pots; naming the shards makes the reference clear.

veranderings.voor: koppe gevind wat die eerste boere van klei gemaak en gebak het
veranderings.na: koppe gevind wat deur die eerste boere van klei gemaak en gebak is
veranderings.rede: In the active relative clause 'wat' can grammatically be read as the subject (the heads made the farmers); the passive with 'deur' removes the ambiguity.
